package client

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
)

// OfflineDiagnosticOperation identifies the admitted public operation, not a
// native bridge mode or an authority capability.
type OfflineDiagnosticOperation uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticOperationUnknown OfflineDiagnosticOperation = iota
	OfflineDiagnosticStatus
	OfflineDiagnosticEnable
	OfflineDiagnosticUpdate
	OfflineDiagnosticDisable
)

type OfflineDiagnosticCoverage uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown OfflineDiagnosticCoverage = iota
	OfflineDiagnosticCoverageComplete
)

type OfflineDiagnosticOutcome uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticOutcomeUnknown OfflineDiagnosticOutcome = iota
	OfflineDiagnosticResolvedTrue
	OfflineDiagnosticResolvedFalse
	OfflineDiagnosticResolvedOther
	OfflineDiagnosticRejected
)

// OfflineDiagnosticReason is the exact closed native bridge V3 reason enum.
type OfflineDiagnosticReason uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticNone OfflineDiagnosticReason = iota
	OfflineDiagnosticEntryRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticParentRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticFrameRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticChildRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticRegistrationRefused
	OfflineDiagnosticNativeReadThrow
	OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow
)

const OfflineRecoveryObservationLimit = 8192

// OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic is a bounded value copy of one admitted attempt's
// actual receipts. It is separate from confirmed OfflineState. No field grants
// authority or retains a browser object. Unsupported evidence remains unknown.
type OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic struct {
	uncertain bool
	frameUncertain bool
	Version uint8 `json:"version"`
	DiagnosticRevision uint32 `json:"diagnosticRevision"`
	Operation OfflineDiagnosticOperation `json:"operation"`
	RuntimeID string `json:"runtimeID"`
	ConfigurationID string `json:"configurationID"`
	Available bool `json:"available"`
	Coverage OfflineDiagnosticCoverage `json:"coverage"`
	LogicalReturned bool `json:"logicalReturned"`
	CleanupKnown bool `json:"cleanupKnown"`
	Overflow bool `json:"overflow"`
	Failure OfflineDiagnosticReason `json:"failure"`
	Update OfflineDiagnosticNative `json:"update"`
	Unregister OfflineDiagnosticNative `json:"unregister"`
	Register OfflineDiagnosticNative `json:"register"`
	Status OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation `json:"status"`
	DisableRecovered OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation `json:"disableRecovered"`
	Frame OfflineDiagnosticFrame `json:"frame"`
	Registry OfflineDiagnosticRegistry `json:"registry"`
}

type OfflineDiagnosticNative struct {
	Covered bool
	Issued, Returned, Terminal uint8
	Outcome OfflineDiagnosticOutcome
	ExactReceiver bool
}

type OfflineDiagnosticACK struct {
	State string `json:"state"`
	Error string `json:"error"`
	Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
	Supported bool `json:"supported"`
	DeferredCleanup bool `json:"deferredCleanup"`
	RuntimeID string `json:"runtimeID"`
	ConfigurationID string `json:"configurationID"`
}

type OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation struct {
	Covered bool
	Issued, Returned, BindingExact, WorkerURLExact, Terminal bool
	StartKnown, StartReturned bool
	Port1CloseReturned, Port2CloseReturned, OnceListenerObserved bool
	ChannelsCreated, ListenerAdds, ListenerRemoves, TrustedEvents, DuplicateTerminals uint8
	ACK OfflineDiagnosticACK
}

type OfflineDiagnosticFrame struct {
	ListenerAdds, ListenerRemoves uint8
	BalanceKnown bool
}

type OfflineDiagnosticRegistry struct {
	InitialInventoryKnown bool `json:"initialInventoryKnown"`
	FinalInventoryKnown bool `json:"finalInventoryKnown"`
	FinalAbsent bool `json:"-"`
	ParentPostRetirementInventoryKnown bool `json:"parentPostRetirementInventoryKnown"`
	ParentPostRetirementAbsent bool `json:"-"`
}

// The nullable wire scalars are temporary encoding values. The public snapshot
// itself remains pointer-free, contains no collections, and is copied by value.
type offlineDiagnosticCount struct { known bool; value uint8 }
func (v offlineDiagnosticCount) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if !v.known { return []byte("null"), nil }
	return strconv.AppendUint(nil, uint64(v.value), 10), nil
}
type offlineDiagnosticBoolean struct { known, value bool }
func (v offlineDiagnosticBoolean) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if !v.known { return []byte("null"), nil }
	return strconv.AppendBool(nil, v.value), nil
}
type offlineDiagnosticACKWire struct { known bool; value OfflineDiagnosticACK }
func (v offlineDiagnosticACKWire) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if !v.known { return []byte("null"), nil }
	return json.Marshal(v.value)
}

func (v OfflineDiagnosticNative) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if !v.Covered { v.Outcome = OfflineDiagnosticOutcomeUnknown }
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		Covered bool `json:"covered"`
		Issued offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"issued"`
		Returned offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"returned"`
		Terminal offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"terminal"`
		Outcome OfflineDiagnosticOutcome `json:"outcome"`
		ExactReceiver offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"exactReceiver"`
	}{v.Covered, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.Issued}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.Returned}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.Terminal}, v.Outcome, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered && v.Issued != 0,v.ExactReceiver}})
}

func (v OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		Covered bool `json:"covered"`
		Issued offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"issued"`
		Returned offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"returned"`
		BindingExact offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"bindingExact"`
		WorkerURLExact offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"workerURLExact"`
		Terminal offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"terminal"`
		StartReturned offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"startReturned"`
		Port1CloseReturned offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"port1CloseReturned"`
		Port2CloseReturned offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"port2CloseReturned"`
		OnceListenerObserved offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"onceListenerObserved"`
		ChannelsCreated offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"channelsCreated"`
		ListenerAdds offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"listenerAdds"`
		ListenerRemoves offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"listenerRemoves"`
		TrustedEvents offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"trustedEvents"`
		DuplicateTerminals offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"duplicateTerminals"`
		ACK offlineDiagnosticACKWire `json:"ack"`
	}{v.Covered, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.Issued}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.Returned}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered && v.Terminal,v.BindingExact}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered && v.Issued,v.WorkerURLExact}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.Terminal}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered && v.StartKnown,v.StartReturned}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.Port1CloseReturned}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.Port2CloseReturned}, offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.Covered,v.OnceListenerObserved}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.ChannelsCreated}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.ListenerAdds}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.ListenerRemoves}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.TrustedEvents}, offlineDiagnosticCount{v.Covered,v.DuplicateTerminals}, offlineDiagnosticACKWire{v.Covered && v.Terminal,v.ACK}})
}

func (v OfflineDiagnosticFrame) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		ListenerAdds offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"listenerAdds"`
		ListenerRemoves offlineDiagnosticCount `json:"listenerRemoves"`
		BalanceKnown bool `json:"balanceKnown"`
	}{offlineDiagnosticCount{v.BalanceKnown,v.ListenerAdds},offlineDiagnosticCount{v.BalanceKnown,v.ListenerRemoves},v.BalanceKnown})
}
func (v OfflineDiagnosticRegistry) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		InitialInventoryKnown bool `json:"initialInventoryKnown"`
		FinalInventoryKnown bool `json:"finalInventoryKnown"`
		FinalAbsent offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"finalAbsent"`
		ParentPostRetirementInventoryKnown bool `json:"parentPostRetirementInventoryKnown"`
		ParentPostRetirementAbsent offlineDiagnosticBoolean `json:"parentPostRetirementAbsent"`
	}{v.InitialInventoryKnown,v.FinalInventoryKnown,offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.FinalInventoryKnown,v.FinalAbsent},v.ParentPostRetirementInventoryKnown,offlineDiagnosticBoolean{v.ParentPostRetirementInventoryKnown,v.ParentPostRetirementAbsent}})
}

func offlineDiagnosticHex(value string, length int) bool {
	if len(value) != length { return false }
	for i := 0; i < len(value); i++ { if !(value[i] >= '0' && value[i] <= '9' || value[i] >= 'a' && value[i] <= 'f') { return false } }
	return true
}
func offlineDiagnosticACKValid(v OfflineDiagnosticACK) bool {
	if !offlineDiagnosticHex(v.RuntimeID,20) || !offlineDiagnosticHex(v.ConfigurationID,64) { return false }
	switch v.State { case "disabled", "ready", "staged", "failed", "busy": default: return false }
	switch v.Error {
	case "", "clock-rollback", "storage-failed", "expired", "unsupported-command", "invalid-message", "identity-changed", "locking-unavailable", "waiting-worker", "clients-unavailable", "client-capacity", "sender-uncontrolled", "cleanup-pending", "cleanup-failed", "corrupt-storage", "activation-failed", "update-waiting", "catalog-changed", "quota", "integrity-failed", "download-failed", "unavailable":
	default: return false
	}
	return len(v.State) <= 16 && len(v.Error) <= 32
}
func offlineDiagnosticNativeValid(v OfflineDiagnosticNative) bool {
	return v.Issued <= 2 && v.Returned <= v.Issued && v.Terminal <= v.Returned && v.Outcome <= OfflineDiagnosticRejected
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCValid(v OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation) bool {
	if v.ChannelsCreated > 8 || v.ListenerAdds > 8 || v.ListenerRemoves > v.ListenerAdds || v.TrustedEvents > 8 || v.DuplicateTerminals > 1 { return false }
	if v.Returned && !v.Issued || v.Terminal && !v.BindingExact || v.Terminal && !offlineDiagnosticACKValid(v.ACK) { return false }
	if !v.Terminal && v.ACK != (OfflineDiagnosticACK{}) { return false }
	return true
}

func (v OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic) sanitized() OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic {
	valid := v.Version == 1 && v.Operation <= OfflineDiagnosticDisable && v.Coverage <= OfflineDiagnosticCoverageComplete && v.Failure <= OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow && !v.Overflow
	if v.Available { valid = valid && v.Operation != OfflineDiagnosticOperationUnknown && offlineDiagnosticHex(v.RuntimeID,20) && offlineDiagnosticHex(v.ConfigurationID,64) }
	valid = valid && offlineDiagnosticNativeValid(v.Update) && offlineDiagnosticNativeValid(v.Unregister) && offlineDiagnosticNativeValid(v.Register) && offlineDiagnosticRPCValid(v.Status) && offlineDiagnosticRPCValid(v.DisableRecovered) && v.Frame.ListenerAdds <= 8 && v.Frame.ListenerRemoves <= v.Frame.ListenerAdds
	if !valid || !v.Available {
		reason := v.Failure
		if reason > OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow { reason = OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused }
		return OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic{Version:1, DiagnosticRevision:v.DiagnosticRevision, Overflow:v.Overflow, Failure:reason}
	}
	return v
}

// MarshalJSON encodes only after the caller has copied the observation outside
// the authority mutex. It never serializes native refs or truncates identities.
func (v OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	type wire OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic
	body, err := json.Marshal(wire(v.sanitized()))
	if err != nil { return nil, err }
	if len(body) > OfflineRecoveryObservationLimit { return nil, errors.New("nextgo: offline recovery observation exceeds bound") }
	return body, nil
}
